none: PAS NLM-C0AED7: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted, cuirassed and mantled bust of Roma with spear right. Obverse inscription: VRBS [RO]MA. Reverse description; Wolf suckling twins, two stars over, a branch between the stars. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 14.6mm, Weight: 1.11gms, die axis: 6
